correctness.rationale: For n>=5 queried edges of length n-2 lie along a Hamiltonian path on n-1 vertices. Partitioning forced-positive edges into consecutive blocks gives a Hamiltonian path satisfying arbitrary negatives, then append final vertex to close a cycle. For the upper bound, any n-1 shattered edges must be a spanning path under all-ones; removing one endpoint edge leaves a spanning path on n-1 vertices whose only completion forces that same edge, contradiction. n<=5 cardinalities and explicit checks agree. Own exhaustive enumeration of all 1,3,12,60 undirected cycles n=3..6 gives VC 0,1,3,4, with exactly 360 shattered four-query supports at n=6 and zero shattered five-query supports. Independently checked actual Git JSON certificate blob 106e252cd6cb0516212cd731452afe32e01b5ae4: 31 internal nodes, 32 distinct valid leaf cycle witnesses, all binary path histories and no repeated query; hence Ldim K6 >=5; 60<64 excludes 6. Product VC additivity and Littlestone mistake-bound subadditivity/appended witness trees yield exact 4s,5s.
